Cloud provider has been introduced in this release wave.

If possible, I would recommend the preparation of a second release
candidate (RC2) for the aforementioned providers, which will include fixes
for both.

Sameer Mesiah.

messages.body:
To Amogh & Jens,

The reservations are as follows:

1) apache-airflow-providers-airbyte==5.5.0rc1: The PR #60451 (link:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64051) failed to resolve the Issue
#64048 (link: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/64048). The crux of
the issue is that the execution timeouts are not being enforced in
deferrable mode which is resulting in the Airbyte Sync running past the
execution timeout period.

2) apache-airflow-providers-dbt-cloud==4.9.0rc1: The PR #66449 (link:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/66449) introduced a regression
thereby causing the bug described in Issue #61467 (link:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/61467) to resurface. It is the
same class of bug as the one described in 1) i.e. non-enforcement of
execution timeouts but it applies to DBT Jobs instead of Airbyte syncs.

I have provided a comprehensive update in my comment (link:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/67213#issuecomment-4513298790) on
the provider testing thread as well.

Both are runtime errors that may result in compute resources being consumed
longer than necessary. As the fix is straightforward, I believe we can
justify a second release cut for both of the aforementioned providers.

Thanks,
Sameer Mesiah.
